Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class NewsArticleEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.NewsArticleEntity
@Entity public class NewsArticleEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the news_articles table.

This is a mutable infrastructure class that mirrors the immutable NewsArticle domain record. All mapping between the two types happens inside ArticleStorageAdapter and ArticleIngestionAdapter — this entity never escapes into the domain or application layers.

The url field is stored as VARCHAR(2048) and serves as the deduplication key. NewsArticleRepository.existsByUrl(String) is checked before each insert; duplicate URLs are silently skipped.

The article_id column is the primary key. For RSS-harvested articles it is populated from the feed entry URI or link URL; for manually ingested articles it may be a generated UUID.
